waiAria_report_note: One result per WAI-ARIA 1.2 author requirement, from the rules that check it, judged by WAI-ARIA's own wording. A requirement no rule failed is a question, not a pass: the rules check what the markup states, not everything the requirement covers.
waiAriaRoleNamePresent_title: Roles that require an accessible name have one
waiAriaRoleNamePresent_description: Checks that every element whose role WAI-ARIA requires an accessible name for, and names from the author only, has one.
waiAriaScrollbarControls_title: A scrollbar says what it scrolls
waiAriaScrollbarControls_description: Checks that each scrollbar has aria-controls, which WAI-ARIA requires of the role.
waiAriaScrollbarControls_summary_fail: This scrollbar does not say what it scrolls.
waiAriaScrollbarControls_hint_fail: Add aria-controls with the id of the content it scrolls.
waiAriaFeedArticles_title: A feed owns articles, and only articles
waiAriaFeedArticles_description: Checks that each feed owns at least one article and nothing of another role.
waiAriaFeedArticles_hint_fail_missing: Put each item of the feed in an <article>, or give it role="article".
waiAriaFeedArticles_summary_fail_child: A feed owns this element, which is not an article.
waiAriaFeedArticles_hint_fail_child: Move it out of the feed, or put it inside one of its articles.
waiAriaCaptionContext_title: A caption is in a figure or a table
waiAriaCaptionContext_description: Checks that each element with role caption is a child of a figure, table, grid or treegrid in the accessibility tree.
waiAriaCaptionContext_summary_cantTell: This caption is not in a figure or a table.
waiAriaCaptionContext_hint_cantTell: Make it a direct child of the figure or table it describes, and name that element by it with aria-labelledby.
waiAriaPresentationalAttributes_title: A presentational element carries no state it cannot have
waiAriaPresentationalAttributes_descript: Checks that elements with role none or presentation carry no aria-* attribute but the global ones.
waiAriaPresentationalAttributes_summary_: This element's role hides it, but it has {{attributes}}.
waiAriaPresentationalAttributes_hint_can: Give it the role the attribute belongs to, or remove the attribute.
waiAriaToolbarNames_title: Each of several toolbars has a name
waiAriaToolbarNames_description: Checks that each toolbar has an accessible name where the page has more than one.
waiAriaToolbarNames_summary_fail: This toolbar has no name, and the page has {{count}} toolbars.
waiAriaToolbarNames_hint_fail: Name each toolbar, with aria-label or aria-labelledby, so they can be told apart.
waiAriaComboboxPopup_title: A combobox's popup is a listbox, tree, grid or dialog
waiAriaComboboxPopup_description: Checks that the element a combobox's aria-controls names has role listbox, tree, grid or dialog.
waiAriaComboboxPopup_summary_fail: This combobox controls an element of role {{role}}, not a listbox, tree, grid or dialog.
waiAriaComboboxPopup_hint_fail: Give the popup the role of what it is (listbox for a list of options), or point aria-controls at the popup.
waiAriaSpinbuttonOwned_title: A spinbutton owns only a textbox and up to two buttons
waiAriaSpinbuttonOwned_description: Checks that each spinbutton owns no element but one textbox and up to two buttons.
waiAriaSpinbuttonOwned_summary_fail_othe: A spinbutton owns this element, of role {{role}}, though it may own only a textbox and buttons.
waiAriaSpinbuttonOwned_hint_fail_other: Move it out of the spinbutton, or make it the spinbutton's text box or one of its two buttons.
waiAriaSpinbuttonOwned_summary_fail_tooM: This spinbutton owns {{textboxes}} text boxes and {{buttons}} buttons, more than one text box and two buttons.
waiAriaSpinbuttonOwned_hint_fail_tooMany: Keep one text box and the increment and decrement buttons in it, and move the rest out.
waiAriaTableIndexes_title: A table's counts and indexes agree with its rows and cells
waiAriaTableIndexes_description: Checks that aria-colindex and aria-rowindex grow along a table and stay within aria-colcount and aria-rowcount, and that the counts are not below the columns and rows on the page.
waiAriaTableIndexes_summary_fail_colinde: This cell's aria-colindex ({{colindex}}) is not greater than an earlier cell's in its row ({{previous}}).
waiAriaTableIndexes_hint_fail_colindexOr: Number the cells of each row from left to right, each above the one before.
waiAriaTableIndexes_summary_fail_colinde: This cell's aria-colindex ({{colindex}}) is above the table's aria-colcount ({{colcount}}).
waiAriaTableIndexes_hint_fail_colindexCo: Make aria-colcount the number of columns in the full table, or correct the index.
waiAriaTableIndexes_summary_fail_rowinde: This row's aria-rowindex ({{rowindex}}) is not greater than an earlier row's ({{previous}}).
waiAriaTableIndexes_hint_fail_rowindexOr: Number the rows from top to bottom, each above the one before.
waiAriaTableIndexes_summary_fail_rowinde: This row's aria-rowindex ({{rowindex}}) is above the table's aria-rowcount ({{rowcount}}).
waiAriaTableIndexes_hint_fail_rowindexCo: Make aria-rowcount the number of rows in the full table, or correct the index.
waiAriaTableIndexes_summary_fail_colcoun: This table's aria-colcount ({{colcount}}) is below the {{columns}} columns a row of it spans.
waiAriaTableIndexes_hint_fail_colcount: Set aria-colcount to the number of columns in the full table, or to -1 if it is not known.
waiAriaTableIndexes_summary_fail_rowcoun: This table's aria-rowcount ({{rowcount}}) is below the {{rows}} rows it has on the page.
waiAriaTableIndexes_hint_fail_rowcount: Set aria-rowcount to the number of rows in the full table, or to -1 if it is not known.
waiAriaSetsize_title: aria-setsize is the number of items in the set
waiAriaSetsize_description: Checks that the items of a set all give the same aria-setsize, and none below the number of items the set has on the page.
waiAriaSetsize_summary_fail_below: This item's aria-setsize ({{setsize}}) is below the {{count}} items of its set on the page.
waiAriaSetsize_hint_fail_below: Set aria-setsize to the number of items in the whole set, or to -1 if it is not known.
waiAriaSetsize_summary_fail_inconsistent: The items of this set give different sizes: {{sizes}}.
waiAriaSetsize_hint_fail_inconsistent: Give every item of the set the same aria-setsize, the number of items in the whole set.
waiAriaKeyshortcuts_title: aria-keyshortcuts names its modifier keys exactly, first
waiAriaKeyshortcuts_description: Checks that each shortcut in aria-keyshortcuts names its modifier keys as UI Events does (Alt, AltGraph, Control, Meta, Shift), before its other keys.
waiAriaKeyshortcuts_summary_fail_name: The shortcut {{shortcut}} names a modifier key "{{key}}", which UI Events calls "{{modifier}}".
waiAriaKeyshortcuts_hint_fail_name: Name modifier keys exactly as UI Events does: Alt, AltGraph, Control, Meta, Shift.
waiAriaKeyshortcuts_summary_fail_order: The shortcut {{shortcut}} puts the modifier key {{key}} after another key.
waiAriaKeyshortcuts_hint_fail_order: Put modifier keys first and the other keys last: {{ordered}}.
